name: Data.negIndex_posRowIndex_spec
summary: By cases on the defining conditions.

steps.claim: Unfold negIndex, posRowIndex and basisVec and split on their conditions: the indices are distinct (injectivity of the basis numbering and of the block embeddings), and the signs are those of signsW (−1 from position k + j − 1 on) and of the padding blocks (grind).
steps.lean:
refine ⟨⟨?_, fun _ ↦ ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro <;> intros <;>
    simp_all [negIndex, posRowIndex, basisVec] <;> split_ifs at * <;> simp_all [signsW] <;> grind
